limiter_policy: No positivity or modal limiting in any arm; all optional nonfinite/admissibility/conservation scans off

configuration.numerical_source_note: The worktree HEAD contains documentation after numerical source 30a472fd; use the already qualified frozen binary without rebuilding.

common_operator.A: Current original FP64 consistent mass/diffusion/exact SIPG face operator; refreshed coefficients at every stage
common_operator.P: Projected element-local spectral inverse, FP64 WMMA factors, initial reference once and current heterogeneous mass scaling
common_operator.fixed_update: sigma <- sigma + omega * P * (b - A sigma)

configuration.omega_explanation: Omega 0.2 applies a smaller relaxation correction than 0.7. It is stronger under-relaxation, with modal damping still zero. It changes the initial 50 corrections as well as regular corrections.

environment_policy.control_names: Canonical unprefixed keys; runner clears inherited IGRLAB_ and DG_IGR_ variables and applies each control under both aliases
environment_policy.CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: preserve scheduler binding; never choose a second device

diagnostic_policy.note: Existing wall timing partitions remain identical in all arms. The converged method still performs its required current FP64 residual certificate.

count_expectations.basis: Historical full DGSEM Sedov no-limiter trajectory; prediction only, actual CFL trajectories may differ
count_expectations.correction_counters: One current A and one P application per fixed correction; no extra true-residual probe requested

comparison_policy.minor_CFL_step_count_differences: report; do not reject solely for differing nominal counts
comparison_policy.physical_sampling: Native polynomial fields evaluated with existing mapped GL8 comparison, finite native and derived fields and positive sampled density/pressure required for usability
comparison_policy.q_sigma: report final native admission and sampled minimum
comparison_policy.error_thresholds: No user-approved approximation error threshold; report differences without inventing a pass budget
comparison_policy.fixed_residual: No convergence certificate or tolerance claim for fixed sweeps
comparison_policy.accuracy_scope: Comparison to a converged closure on this spatial/temporal discretization; no discretization error or continuous positivity claim

retention_policy.note: Compare all qualified final fields remotely. Retain two preferred raw final VTUs in the compressed archive: fixed50/4 omega.2 plus FGMRES when available, otherwise the two fixed finals. Prune the old fixed final after comparisons; 3 GiB bounds the compressed archive plus compact receipts. Intermediate native cycles are removed after each arm.

interpretation_limits: Omega .2 is stronger under-relaxation per correction than.7. This is solver relaxation, not modal damping or a change to physical IGR alpha.
Changing omega also changes the50 initial approximate corrections; current2andnew4 change both regular count and relaxation.
FGMRES uses the same projected element-local FP64 WMMA P as fixed corrections. It is not the historical Q1/two-level or global Cartesian TF32 reference.
Full physical window, executable, geometry, discretization, optional scans, output schedule and GPU are matched. No repeat-based confidence interval is claimed.
Fixed sigma has no convergence certificate. Conserved flow and sigma differences are reported independently; engineering thresholds are not discretization-error bounds.
Saved-field GL8 positivity does not prove positivity between samples or all times.
Only this fixed512²Q2mappedp5GLL case is measured; no mesh/p-order/MPI/3D extrapolation.
